question: Bhakra Dam is built on which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satluj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bhakra Dam** is built on the **Satluj River**.
 
• It is located in the **state of Himachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• The dam is one of the **highest gravity dams** in the world, with a height of 226 meters.
 
• The primary purpose of the dam is for **irrigation, hydroelectric power generation, and flood control**.
 
• The dam is a part of the **Bhakra-Nangal Project**, which also includes the **Nangal Dam** located downstream.
 
• The reservoir created by the Bhakra Dam is known as **Gobind Sagar Lake**.
 
• The dam provides water for **irrigating millions of hectares of agricultural land** in the states of Punjab, Haryana, and Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chenab River**__

 __
 
• The **Chenab River** is one of the major rivers of the Indus River system.
 
• It originates from the **Lahaul and Spiti district** of Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• The river flows through the Indian-administered region of Jammu and Kashmir, and then into Pakistan.
 
• It is known for its **hydroelectric power potential**, with several dams and power projects planned or under construction.
 
 
 
• **Ravi River**__
 __
 
• The **Ravi River** is another important river in the Indus River system.
 
• It flows through the Indian states of **Himachal Pradesh and Punjab** and enters Pakistan.
 
• The river is a vital source for **irrigation** and supports agricultural activities in the regions it flows through.
 
 
 
• **Beas River**__
 
 
• The **Beas River** originates from the **Himalayas** in central Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• It flows through the Indian state of **Punjab** before joining the Satluj River.
 
• The river is known for its **picturesque valleys** and is a popular destination for tourism and adventure sports.
